turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
"Heard my points." I asked you two questions, and you've answered neither. Was it you who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before you did?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
"Make noise until the facts go away." I haven't heard a single fact from you yet. Put one on the table, or I'm walking to the principal's office when we're done.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.

My son does not lie, and I'm writing down that you just called him a cheater with nothing in front of you. Now you're accusing his mother too? That sentence goes to the principal today, word for word.
